tests.note: on a board with a display stub for the splash process (stub_splash_on in the image), the process must have drawn the banner at boot: it logs this record after lv_refr_now() and just before it terminates. The log is a ring of 200 records (KRECORD_SZ_LOG_BUF), so the record is gone on a board that has logged that many since its reset - reset it and run again
